note: Voiced phone calls for galle_storm. Each entry turns the scenario complaint with that id into a call: `spoken` is what the caller says first (synthetic voice, fictional caller), `withheld` lists facts they only give when the agent asks, `voice`/`rate` pick the edge-tts voice. Audio: scripts/make_calls.py -> media/audio/calls/galle_storm/<id>.wav. Non-English lines need a native-speaker check.

C01.spoken: Hello? Hello, yes. The current is gone at my house. The whole road is dark, all the houses. Can you please check?

C02.spoken: හලෝ, මම කතා කරන්නේ රෝහල පාරේ අංක 47 ඉඳන්. කරන්ට් නැහැ. ලොකු සද්දයක් ආවා, කණුවක් වැටිලා වගේ.

C03.spoken: Hello, this is the Galle Teaching Hospital annex on Hospital Road, account {account}. We have lost mains power. The generator is running, but we need the power back urgently.

C23.spoken: வணக்கம். பம்பிங் ஸ்டேஷன் ரோட், 30ஆம் இலக்கம். எங்கள் வீட்டில் மின்சாரம் இல்லை.
